plugin.notes: 2.6.2: finds the Orca CLI on Windows even when Orca hides USERPROFILE from plugins. 2.6.1: phones stay paired through plugin updates, relay redeploys and reinstalls; one-click Update now; security updates turn the relay off until installed. Since 2.6.0 Orca installs plugin updates (Settings → Plugins → Update); coming from 2.5.x, Orca asks you once to review it.

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
